title: Waypoint ledger
subtitle: The closest fit to the existing Guardian HUD.
description: A transparent list, one medallion and the existing muted gold baseline.

title: Editor metal ledger
subtitle: Matches the /sdui diamond-metal frame.
description: A contained list using the editor's fixed corners and stretched edge strips.

title: Character metal panel
subtitle: Plain Blizzard metal, restrained gold text.
description: A compact sibling of the character window with its plain metal frame.

title: Quest header list
subtitle: A published quest-tracker header above open rows.
description: An older retail-style header option; more ornamental than the current HUD.

title: Medallion stack
subtitle: Independent rows built around the Guardian medallion.
description: A smaller repeat of the existing floating waypoint language on every row.

title: State chapters
subtitle: Separate sections for held and vacant lairs.
description: Status grouping keeps fighting and upcoming returns easy to find.

title: Two-column ledger
subtitle: Living on the left, vacant lairs on the right.
description: A wider, shorter list for placement below the minimap.

title: Numbered lair register
subtitle: A compact three-column register in native order.
description: Stable lair numbers, names and a right-aligned status column.

title: Timer bezel rows
subtitle: The same gold-edged pills as the run timer.
description: Each status sits inside a real timer bezel; only known health has a fill.

title: Horizontal nameplates
subtitle: Five small entries in a single row.
description: A wide strip with one medallion per lair and status underneath.

title: Lair tile grid
subtitle: A compact three-by-two arrangement.
description: Five metal tiles with clear state text and a reserved final summary cell.

title: Numbered spine
subtitle: A vertical guide line with small lair badges.
description: One continuous spine keeps the list visually light.

title: Metal row cards
subtitle: Shallow character-panel cards for each guardian.
description: Native stat-card pieces form individual rows without a surrounding window.

title: Fight focus
subtitle: A larger active fight beside the complete roster.
description: Highlights the fighting guardian's actual health; all other lairs stay listed.

title: Next return focus
subtitle: A large return time beside the held lairs.
description: A readable native countdown without inventing a respawn progress percentage.

title: Micro ledger
subtitle: The narrowest complete list.
description: A very small open ledger with concise, readable status text.

title: Soft shadow ledger
subtitle: A fading dark backdrop borrowed from Level Up.
description: The soft backdrop supports the text without another hard window border.

title: Highlighted register
subtitle: A single focus row with the editor's gold selection.
description: A list that can later show the selected lair; the preview demonstrates the artwork only.

title: Bottom status tray
subtitle: Five evenly spaced state cells in a thin tray.
description: A low, wide alternative intended near the action-bar stack.

title: Waypoint companion
subtitle: The current guidance label above a matching roster.
description: Reuses the visual proportions of the existing Guardian guidance HUD.
